title: Refund policy
html:
At Analog Attic, we want every purchase to be a happy one. If something isn't right with your order, we're here to help.

Requesting a Return

You can request a return within 30 days of delivery. Please email hello@analogattic.example with your order number, the item you would like to return and the reason. We will reply with return instructions if your item is eligible. Please contact us before sending anything back, as unauthorised returns may not be processed.

Return Eligibility

To be eligible, items should generally be:

  • Unused and in the same condition you received them.
  • In their original packaging.
  • Accompanied by an order number or proof of purchase.

Unless an item is damaged or faulty, the cost of return shipping is paid by the customer. These conditions do not limit any rights you have under applicable consumer protection laws.

Damaged, Faulty or Incorrect Items

If an item arrives damaged, faulty or not as ordered, contact us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos. We will arrange a replacement or refund once we have reviewed the issue.

Refunds

Once your return has been received and inspected, we will email you to confirm the outcome. Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method, and your bank may take a few more business days to show them.
